## `set_project_name`

*Available in [Python](#set_project_name-python), [CLI](#set_project_name-cli)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Sets the project name field of a CIDA project.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    set_project_name(
        project_name: str | None,
        project: CIDAProject = None
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_name` (`str | None`) - The new value for the project name field. If None, will *unset* the value.
    - `project` (`CIDAProject`) - The CIDA project to set a new name for. If none is specified, uses the value of `current_project()`.

    <h4>Returns `None`</h4>

    None
